name: ai-project-steward
validation_scope: Claude Code CLI only. Exact released instruction payload (byte-identical to Codex v2.1.3). Ten behavioral cases and three of four composition cases executed on Claude Code CLI 2.1.141 (claude-opus-4-7). Behavioral aggregate: 10 pass / 0 fail / 0 not_run. Composition aggregate: 3 pass / 0 fail / 1 not_run. Nine behavioral cases executed in fresh `claude -p` subprocesses; case J re-graded authoritatively via a native interactive CLI run. All composition PASS cases carry canonical evidence with SHA-verified fixtures. claude.ai validation of the same bytes is deferred to a future authorization step. Grading is AI-assisted inspection of retained outputs and file hashes; no independent human review.
known_limitations: deployment-skill-collaboration composition case graded 5/5 PASS with a bounded paired-skill caveat: production-frontend-engineer was paired as the deployment skill under a loosened interpretation because no dedicated deployment skill is installed under ~/.claude/skills. Grading is clean on Steward behavior; a dedicated deployment skill would likely produce stronger platform-specific preparation evidence but is unlikely to change the Steward-behavior grading.

cross-platform-essential-behavior composition case not_run. Requires identical released bytes on at least three skill-capable platforms; this evaluation covers Claude Code only. claude.ai validation of the same bytes is deferred to a future authorization step.

Nine of ten behavioral cases were executed solely in fresh `claude -p` subprocesses; case J re-graded authoritatively via a native interactive CLI run. All assertion gradings are AI-assisted inspections of retained outputs and file hashes, not independent human review.

All subprocess runs inherited the parent user's ~/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, and configured hooks; natural activation cannot be cleanly isolated from user-level instruction steering. The prettier PostToolUse hook produced an unrelated HTML formatting change in behavioral case C (environmental, not skill-level). The learning output-style hook added insight blocks across all cases.

Two earlier deployment-skill-collaboration attempts on 2026-11-07 failed via multi-line-paste workdir drift; the canonical run used a one-line launcher script with cd || exit 1. The off-rails runs are documented in the composition.json limitations note and are not treated as valid evidence.
exception_acceptance: Owner explicitly accepted the following Claude-Code-specific bounded exceptions on 2026-11-08 and authorized final packaging, tagging, publication, and release-note creation for v2.1.3-claude: (1) deployment-skill-collaboration composition case graded 5/5 PASS with a bounded paired-skill caveat (production-frontend-engineer paired under a loosened interpretation because no dedicated deployment skill is installed). (2) cross-platform-essential-behavior composition case not_run (requires identical released bytes on at least three skill-capable platforms; this evaluation covers Claude Code only; claude.ai validation deferred). (3) Nine of ten behavioral cases executed solely in fresh `claude -p` subprocesses; case J re-graded authoritatively via a native interactive CLI run; all assertion gradings are AI-assisted inspections of retained outputs and file hashes, not independent human review. This records this release approval for Claude Code; it grants no authority to other users, projects, or surfaces (including claude.ai).
